Research

Applied Research

Hybrid Phishing URL Detection using DeepTCN, Meta-Learning & Concept Drift Monitoring

Problem

Phishing URLs evolve faster than static classifiers can adapt, causing detection performance to silently decay as attacker patterns drift over time.

Methodology

An 80,008-dimensional sparse feature pipeline (TF-IDF character n-grams + lexical features) feeds a stacked ensemble — SGD, DeepTCN+Attention, and Isolation Forest — combined via a Random Forest meta-learner.
